amendments.change: Review renders use a view wrapper that drops zero-area triangles before lifting; validation keeps the strict wrapper and the completion rule is unchanged. measure.mjs also reports zeroAreaTriangles (informational).
amendments.reason: In the pilot the vented-housing control mesh had 4 collinear triangles; the strict lift rejected it, so it also got no image and would have been scored 1 on every item. That tied the blind review to validation strictness, which the protocol did not intend. Agent prompts, briefs, caps and the completion rule are unchanged, so the runs were not repeated.

tools.label: modeling tools
tools.instructions: Use the ForgeaX modeling tools. Read the skill at .claude/skills/forgeax-engine-modeling/SKILL.md first; the full operator contract is reference/modeling-README.md and worked example Packs are under reference/examples/ (their imports use the workspace names @forgeax/engine-modeling and @forgeax/engine-pack/source; in this project import @forgeax/engine/modeling and @forgeax/engine/pack/source). Build the mesh with model() and sel from @forgeax/engine/modeling and return m.finish({ key: 'prop', ... }). Check your work with the `forgeax model` commands (run `forgeax help model`; for example `forgeax model validate --source assets/prop.pack.ts --json` and `forgeax model render --source assets/prop.pack.ts --json`, then Read the PNG files it reports). assets/prop.pack.ts already contains a minimal starting Pack.

control.label: createMeshBuilder control
control.instructions: Hand-write the triangles yourself with createMeshBuilder from @forgeax/engine/geometry: compute positions, normals, uvs and indices in TypeScript (you may write any helper functions you like inside the assets/ directory) and return { 'mesh/prop': mesh }. The builder contract is reference/geometry-README.md (section MeshBuilder) and reference/mesh-builder.ts. Do not use @forgeax/engine/modeling or any `forgeax model` command; this run measures the hand-written path. assets/prop.pack.ts already contains a minimal starting Pack (a single box).

completion: build ok AND measure.closed AND measure.manifold AND measure.oriented AND every component volume > 0 AND every brief check passes AND the lifted mesh's forgeax model validate status is not fail AND no protocol violation. Judged on the artifact left in assets/ when the run ends, whether or not a cap was hit.

review.judge: separate claude -p call, same model, no condition labels
review.image: forgeax model render sheet (front/right/top/iso, orthographic, --annotate false) of the delivered mesh lifted into one material slot with a box UV projection, so material slots and UV choices do not reveal the condition; zero-area triangles are dropped for the image only (amendment 1.1)
review.proxyNote: An LLM judge is a proxy for the human blind review that design section 15 calls for; it can share biases with the agents under test.

rubric.source: Tiangong docs/reviews/RUBRIC.md at 24330ac8 (blind review sheet, 8 items, 1-5 each); English rendering below

items.five: Clear subject, guided eye, intentional framing
items.one: Subject cut off, frame empty or cluttered

items.five: Key light plus contrasting fill and local light sources; light has a source and volume
items.one: Flat, gray, blown out or crushed black

items.five: One material shows three states (new / worn / scorched); metal, paint and primer clearly distinct
items.one: Looks like plastic or a flat color

items.five: Welding sparks, steam, exhaust, explosions with layering
Instantly clear what it is and what it is doing
Fits 'ash and copper, man-made industry vs AI ceramic'
Foreground, midground and background all have content; dynamic elements; local lights; volume; a material story; scale references
Contrast of man-made and native: human armor assembly, weld seams, rivets, handmade feel vs seamless AI geometry

rubric.note: The sheet's camera, lights and single neutral material are fixed by the harness, so composition, lighting, material and effects measure the harness more than the agent; the report gives the full 8-item mean (the design's metric) and the geometry subset.

verdict.rule: pass when tools completion >= control completion and tools full-rubric mean >= control mean - 0.25; fail when either is worse; below minRunsPerCondition the verdict is inconclusive and only the direction is reported
